Subject: ancient imperial ROME, the Colosseum as a magnificent large intact oval amphitheatre with stacked arcades in three-quarter elevated view, the Roman Forum's classical columns and basilicas receding behind it, terracotta roofs and cypress trees. The Colosseum dominates the central frame and remains unmistakable at thumbnail size. Warm ivory stone, amber late-afternoon sun, burgundy and bronze accents, subtle distant blue hills. Preserve architectural clarity, not fantasy castles or Greek hilltop acropolis. One coherent city panorama.
